body: Malian balafon virtuoso + Mozambican timbila star. NEA National Heritage Fellow.
Vivo Performing Arts gathers and performs on the unceded ancestral lands of the Massachusett, Pawtucket, and Wampanoag peoples.
Assistive listening devices are available. For ASL or audio description on selected performances, contact access@vivo.org at least one week in advance.
